name: launch
about: The launch video: one question's trip through the server, about 55 s. Captions are templates over the real data ({{...}} sees M = model, T = trace).

timeline.question: Why does ice float on water?

card.title: Anatomy of a Token
card.sub: What actually happens inside an AI server when it answers your question

caption.text: A real model, on a real machine.

caption.sub: Pieces of words, each a number the model knows.

caption.text: Every token flows through all {{M.L}} layers.
caption.sub: Each layer reads the whole sentence so far and adds to each token’s meaning.

caption.text: In each layer, {{M.moe.top_k}} of {{M.moe.experts}} experts wake up.
caption.sub: The rest stay idle. That is how a huge model stays fast.

caption.text: It scores all {{int(M.vocab)}} possible next tokens…
caption.sub: These are its real top five, from the server.
Then it does it again, for the next token.

caption.text: Guess {{M.spec.k}} ahead, check them all at once.
caption.sub: A small drafter guesses; the model keeps every guess it agrees with.
Each step runs only the newest tokens. The prompt is never read again.

card.title: Every number here is real.
card.sub: Read from the model’s own files and the server, live. Try it on your model, on your hardware.
